recipes.name: Emily's Strawberry Balsamic Salad
ingredients_raw: 1 head red lettuce leaves, rinsed, dried, and torn
0.5 small red onion, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch-wide slivers
1 pint fresh strawberries, rinsed and sliced

steps.text: To make the dressing, place the balsamic vinegar, Dijon mustard, honey, shallot, garlic, salt, and pepper in the bowl of a mini food processor. Pulse until blended. Slowly pour in the olive oil, and pulse again until thoroughly blended. Set aside or refrigerate until needed.
Divide lettuce between 6 serving plates, and top with red onion, almonds, strawberries, and feta cheese. Serve dressing on the side.

raw_recipe.headline: Emily's Strawberry Balsamic Salad
raw_recipe.description: Bursting with tangy flavor, a rich balsamic dressing seasoned with garlic, mustard, honey, and shallots perfectly complements a green salad garnished with strawberries, toasted almonds, and feta cheese.

review.reviewBody: Oh, yum!! I took this to a work potluck & everyone really liked it. I didn't have the full amount of honey or the shallot, but the dressing was still wonderful. Thanks for the recipe!

Delicious dressing, very easy to make and was a perfect compliment to the salad and strawberries. Made my salad with strawberries, bleu cheese, homemade candid walnuts, red onion, and I mixed spring mix with spinach and romaine. 
The dressing was very thick, so I watered it down and it stayed perfectly blended/emulsified (probably about 3/4 cup water). This brought down calories per serving and allowed for easier tossing. We served with grilled steak (which is why I went with bleu cheese) Very light and fresh. Amazing! A definite keeper.

This salad was fantastic! I only made a couple minor changes. I used a 50/50 spring mix-spinach blend for the salad, omitted the shallot and I toasted the almonds in a frying pan with a teaspoon of butter and pinch of salt. Myself and our dinner guests were blown away by how good the dressing was. So delicious and simple.

Love, love , love! I have made this now 5 times in December for different holiday parties. It's a huge success! I added pine nuts to it. I also tried cut up apples when I was out of strawberries and goat cheese crumbles one night and it was still delicious.

I modified a little: 
- used half of the olive oil (I think it can still be reduced!) 
- added cucumber and carrot to replace the red onion
- used yellow mustard because I don't have djon mustard
- used rose apples to replace the strawberry 
- used freshly grated cheddar cheese to replace feta cheese 

This recipe is fantastic! It's a MUST-TRY and fail-proof recipe. I love it to the max. In this recipe, I used my homegrown romaine lettuce and rose apples. It makes one wants for more!

I’m pleasantly surprised by this. All the flavours, the tangy kick with the sweetness of the strawberries and then the feta. Yeah it’s a keeper! As it’s just me, I made the dressing based on 6 but stored in a glass jar in the fridge and used a measuring spoon to drizzle some on. I think I’ll get more than 6 from mine but that’s okay ☺️ I can add it over and over. I will make again! Thank you!

Awesome recipe. Had enough dressing to make the salad a second time. The toasted almonds really add to the texture so don’t skip that. I also added some chicken breast that I pan fried in olive oil. Make sure you chop it up and toss it in with the dressing. A crowd pleaser ;)

I LOVE THIS SALAD! I used candied pecans (cause that's what I had) and the biggest change was an addition of grilled shrimp because I was serving this as our evening meal. YUMMY! I also used a mix of baby spinach and lettuces as I always try to up the health benefits with spinach in my salads. As others have said the marriage of the dressing, strawberries and feta is awesome!

Modified this for the HCG diet and it's absolutely delicious! Used a couple tblsp water instead of oil, 1/2 tbsp liquid stevia instead of honey and second time making it, I used onion powder instead of shallot. It was terrific both ways and had a little less bite to it with the onion powder (though I do love shallots). I also added about a tsp of thyme and oregano. I put this dressing on everything and have even used it as a marinade. Yum!

Great recipe! I didn't have any shallots, but this dressing is incredible! I was lazy and just put all the ingredients for the dressing in a Tupperware container and shook it up really good and it emulsified pretty good. Some leftover chicken would be great on top of this too! Thank you for a great recipe, Emily!
I made the dressing and then added a little more honey to balance the flavor and tartness of the mustard. It was a hit at the Bridal Shower. Sharing the recipe!!!

I have been making this salad for many years now, it's always been a great hit!! I have not made any changes other than once in awhile instead of the feta cheese we put blue cheese in. I would not rate a recipe if I made multiple changes like some people do! Thank you Emily for the great recipe.
Great recipe for a hot day. I marinated some chicken in the basalmic dressing and bar-b-qued it on the grill.
Loved it. I followed the recipe and it turned out great.
Very good will make again
I think this is a great and easy recipe. I couldn’t fine any shallot so I didn’t use any but it still turned out great. I am a fan of vinaigrette and this one is definitely a favorite !!
excellent!!
Great salad. Will definitely make it again. Probably tomorrow.
spinach walnuts & craisens
Huge hit at 4th of July party!!! Everyone wanted more!
